engine.failedBody: Rendering and diagnostics are off. Your text is safe and editing still works.
engine.renderCrashed: The render engine crashed; the next export will restart it.

pageView.publishConfirm: Unpublish this note? Public records may be mirrored by firehose services and cannot be recalled.
pageView.publishHint: Public records are readable by anyone. Unpublishing deletes the record; firehose mirrors may retain copies.

settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.name: Name
settings.customPaletteHint: Overrides the selected theme for the app and rendered pages.
settings.themeError: Custom palette is not valid JSON of token -> color.
settings.uiSizeHint: Scales chrome text, buttons, and icons.
settings.uiRadiusHint: Scales rounded corners across the app.
settings.templateHint: New daily notes render this Typst source. Placeholders: {'{title}'} (formatted title), {'{date}'} (ISO date), {'{weekday}'} (weekday), {'{previous}'} (nearest previous note) and {'{next}'} (nearest next note).
settings.preludeHint: Appended before every page compile (editor, previews, published pages). Use new Typst functions or #set rules here to build custom views.
settings.spellcheckHint: Native uses the browser's own checker. Harper is a local grammar checker: its model is fetched once and text never leaves the device.
settings.spellcheckDictionaryHint: Words Harper should not flag. "Add to dictionary" on a spelling suggestion appends here.
settings.spellcheckDictionaryNative: The browser checker keeps its own dictionary; add words from its context menu. This list applies to Harper.
settings.spellcheckIgnoredHint: Ignoring is tied to the surrounding context, so editing near a silenced lint can bring it back.
settings.notebookCountersHint: Show the [n] run counter in cell headers.
settings.editorLineNumbersHint: Show source line numbers in the editor gutter.
settings.editorSoftWrapHint: Wrap long lines at the pane width. Turn off to scroll them horizontally.
settings.editorScrollPastEndHint: Keep scroll room below the document so the cursor line is not pinned to the bottom edge.
settings.aiEnableHint: Off by default: nothing is generated or sent to a provider until you enable this.
settings.keysHint: Keys stay in local.json, never in synced settings.
settings.syncSignInHint: Sign in with an atproto account to sync this workspace between devices and publish pages. Until then everything stays on this device.
settings.syncNewHereHint: Any atproto account works here, including one you already use with other atproto apps.
settings.syncAlpha: Cross-device sync is in alpha and needs a PDS that supports atproto Spaces. Signing in still lets you publish pages.
settings.syncOff: Sync is off for this account.
settings.syncPlaintext: Record data is plaintext to every member of the space.
settings.syncRelayOff: Live relay offline; edits still sync through the PDS.
settings.syncRequiresServer: Sync requires the app server (OAuth client metadata). Running a static build keeps this workspace fully local.
settings.systemFontsHint: Installs every system font into the Typst engine, so documents can use any installed family.
settings.cannotEnumerate: This browser cannot enumerate system fonts.
settings.textSizeHint: Base text size in pt. 1 pt renders as 1 px on screen, so 16pt matches the editor's 16px text.
settings.storageHint: Where this device keeps workspaces. Changing it shows that location's own workspace list.
settings.aiHint: Chat is off by default. Nothing is sent to a provider until you enable it.
settings.aiPageContext: Include the open page and selection
settings.aiTools: Let the model search and read notes

palette.rebuildHint: Drops the index and reads every page again.

newPage.title: New page

notebook.commandHint: Enter edits · A/B add · DD deletes · M/Y type

exportPage.dialogHint: The Typst project compiles outside the app with typst compile --root . --font-path typbase/fonts.

exportWorkspace.combined: Combine selected pages into one document
exportWorkspace.hint: PDF and SVG for many pages can take a while. Selecting only daily notes and combining creates a chronological archive.
